Root discovery does not resemble a follower leaderboard. Counts and review summaries remain available in person detail; Instagram manual/connected and genuine creator verification remain literal.

Cars remain actual offered inventory. Named zones and asking prices are visible; no installed artwork or 3D control appears for model_url=null.
People-query failure does not erase usable cars. Missing portraits and work remain honest rather than receiving generated filler.

removed_or_hidden: Remove the second vertical people row from For you only. Its people remain in the same ordered native ribbon; the People destination retains the full six-person gallery.
Remove landscape underlay tiles around portrait-format work. Originals use their own aspect ratios and deliberate positions.
Move completed counts, review summaries and follower totals out of the root caption and into the existing person detail. Retain literal provenance and useful work fit at the root.
Do not show request forms, offer negotiation, full portfolios or full placement diagrams in the gallery.
No followers-first treatment, hover-only actions, promotional availability claims, reach estimates or decorative maps.
implementation_steps: Keep the existing shell, heading, attention and local-view logic. Replace only the For you people layout and its captions.
Implement source-ratio spread variants driven by the actual source ratio, not by invented creator categories. Reserve image dimensions before loading.
Use native overflow and proximity snap. Previous/Next move to the next item's offsetLeft, not a hard-coded equal-width step.
Place the existing Request choice at the root as an entry to the same named-recipient flow. Reuse backend permission checks; never bypass request detail or confirmation.
Render People as the existing complete gallery with the new source framing and captions. Render Cars as the existing two-column open gallery, not list rows.
Move the car shelf up by removing the second vertical people row and redundant continuation row; do not use negative positioning.
Verify all six people, independent query failures, missing city, empty inventory, request failure and asking-price versus offer-price separation.

motion_and_interaction: Native ribbon and car-shelf scrolling remain under pointer, trackpad and keyboard control. Button-driven movement is 220ms, cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); reduced motion jumps to the next item.
View changes use the existing 180ms selection edge and 140ms confirmed-results handoff. Do not crossfade two business identities.
View person or vehicle may use a 280ms single-source transition. Money, names and qualifications do not interpolate between records.
Request opens the existing short choice or destination with the recipient visible. Menu entrance is 180ms opacity plus at most 8px translation; reduced motion is immediate.
Portraits and work do not lift, zoom or play on hover. Links underline and controls change color over 140ms.
Any later real model loads only inside vehicle inspection after activation, never on this root.

Keep all six people, all four vehicles, the same discovery views and the same request/offer flows.
